behavior: AC1 — a user_message envelope published to team.<team>.worker.<name> is decoded via the shared internal/protocol package (no Pydantic mirror) and dispatched to the worker.

AC2 — the worker spawns `pi --mode json` with cwd=an isolated git worktree and a prompt from the envelope, consumes its JSONL event stream to agent_end, and removes the worktree on completion (item C, no leaked worktrees). Verified against fake-pi (no real inference).
AC3 — one activity_event on team.<team>.activity per pi tool_execution_* event, and a container_validation envelope on startup; a test subscriber asserts the envelopes decode via internal/protocol.
AC4 (item A) — on SIGTERM the worker terminates the in-flight pi subprocess and drains within a bounded timeout; the pi child is reaped (no orphaned pi process).
AC5 (item B) — when pi exits non-zero or crashes, the worker emits a failure activity_event rather than dropping it silently (fake-pi exits 1 -> failure envelope asserted).
AC6 — the umbrella smoke-test checks #4 (real worker-pi running) and #5 (NATS pub/sub roundtrip) pass with the real worker binary built into compose.dev.yml.
verification: docker compose -f compose.dev.yml up -d --wait && go build -o ./tmp/motor ./cmd/motor && (./tmp/motor & for _ in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS localhost:8080/healthz >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done; make smoke-test); kill %1 2>/dev/null; docker compose -f compose.dev.yml down
